text:
Samira: Quick sync — proposal for a cohort-based migration guardrails runbook. I sketched 3 lanes (fast, gradual, opt-in) + observable gates (perf, quality, cost) + customer opt-out window. Need alignment on thresholds, ownership, and export to Console. Thoughts?

Alex: +1 on lanes. We need concrete numeric gates for rollback. Proposal: latency increase >5% OR quality drop >2% => block rollout. Also require canary for 1k requests or 24h, whichever first.

Devon: For quality we should measure with customer prompt corpus + curated eval sets. Sampling strategy: stratified by top-10 tenants (by qps) + 10% random tail. Statistical test: require significance at p<0.05 before we mark a regression.

Maria: Customers keep asking for co-term controls. Can we expose a "pause migration" toggle per-tenant and a visible migration timeline in the Console? They'll need clear comms + credits if migration causes regression.

Chris: From a product side, the RFC should cover: canary cohort sizing, rollback/auto-pin thresholds, comm templates, crediting policy, and a pin TTL (e.g., 7d soft-pin, 30d hard-pin opt-in).

Samira: Nice list. Also want automatic fallback to compatible model families as a safety net if rollout fails (e.g., route to last-good-family). @Devon — runtime support for family fallback?

Devon: Runtime already supports fallback routing but we lack a customer-facing config surface. Need console + API fields: ``fallback_family``, ``canary_window_ms``, ``cost_gate_pct``. I'll open a tiny EPIC.

Orion-bot: jira: created EPIC RDW-1472 "Migration cohort guardrails: console config + runtime hooks" (owner: Devon)

Alex: Add cost delta gate: if new model increases cost/token >12% we should pause rollout pending approval. Also recommend a soft cap and an override with audit logging.

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll sign up 3 pilot customers for the opt-in lane (two SaaS, one regulated). They'll provide prompt corpora and acceptance criteria.

Samira: Draft config snippet for the runbook (suggested):

```
{
  "lanes": ["fast", "gradual", "opt_in"],
  "canary": {"min_requests": 1000, "max_duration_hours": 24},
  "gates": {"latency_pct": 5, "quality_pct": 2, "cost_pct": 12},
  "stats": {"p_value_threshold": 0.05, "sampling_strategy": "stratified_top10_plus_random10pct"},
  "pin_ttl_days": {"soft": 7, "hard": 30}
}
```
Samira: Next steps: product to draft 1-pager with above gates + comm templates by EOD Thu. Owners: Product (Samira), Eng-Platform (Alex), ML (Devon), CS (Maria). Sync set for Wed 10am in #product. If you have major objections, flag now.

Alex: Works for me. I'll scope Console fields & an API proto before sync.

Devon: I'll prepare benchmark sampling script & a placeholder eval harness.

Maria: I'll coordinate pilot comms and contract check for opt-in terms.

Chris: I'll draft the comm + escalation playbook and a template for credits.

Samira: cool — if no blockers I'll merge this into the migration RFC draft and assign owners.

Alex: ack
